text: BST-Delete(T,z) Ifz =T and zleft = NIL # z is the root, return right child zright.parent = NIL return z.right else if z = T and z.right = NIL # z is the root, return left child z.left.parent = NIL return z.left else: If z.left = NIL and z.right = NIL # z is a leaf If z = z.parent.left z.parent.left = NIL else z.parent.right = NIL 3 e ———— else if zleft = NIL # z has only a right child Replace(z,z.right) else if zright= NIL # z has only a left child Replace(z,z.left) else # z has two children y = Find-Min(z.right) z.key = y.key Replace(y,y.right) return T
